values.note: 30-amp site $25 a night ($400 a month), water from park hydrants; 50-amp site with sewer $45 a night (the page posts both $500 and $675 a month); seasonal prices by phone. Tent $20, $25 with electric; each added tent $10.

note: City of Macomb park on 280-acre Spring Lake north of town, run by Spring Lake Management, Inc. Water comes from hydrants around the park (about 100 ft of hose reaches most sites; hose reels at the host camper). Cabins, boat rentals, bait shop and fishing docks. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read live via headless browser. Confirmed FCFS, $25 30-A / $45 50-A+sewer, showers, dump, store; electric 30 -> 50, sewer added, sites 120 -> 102, laundry and Wi-Fi added. Monthly and seasonal stays also sold (seasonal share unmeasured). Not waterfront kept. Pin OK. No season stated.
flags: LONG-STAY (local; reviewer's call): the operator posts nightly rates and FCFS first, but also $400-675 monthly rates and 'Call for season prices and availability'. A summer image shows ~60 rigs packed in the open-field loop and the north rows; whether those are seasonals is not measurable from the pages. No wording discourages nightly guests. Google 4.7 over 314.

OWNERSHIP: City of Macomb park ('the City of Macomb's police impound lot', 'Spring Lake Management and The City of Macomb'), but the site is (c) 'Spring Lake Management, Inc.' - a management company runs it for the city. 'local' kept; noted for the reviewer.

WATER: 30-A sites have no water at the site ('use of water hydrants throughout the park. 100 ft of hose will suffice'); the 50-A sites are called 'full hook up' on the amenities page but the rate text lists only electric and sewage plus hydrants - hookups.water left unset.
SITES: 102 is the operator's total including tent sites; the RV share is not stated.
SEASON: no statement on the operator pages; left unset.
